part.text:
The robot is standing in front of the red wall at the end of the corridor. I called rest, so it is now crouched with the motors off.

The last camera image shows the red wall filling the view ahead. I'm not certain of the exact gap. The sonar still reads about 1.3 m to the left and right, so it may be less close than the image suggests. Nothing bumped or fell along the way.
